$comment: Single source of truth for model routing. Read by the model-router skill, enforced by .claude/hooks/model-routing.mjs, checked by .claude/hooks/tests. Model aliases verified on Claude Code 2.1.329 (haiku=claude-haiku-5-5, sonnet=claude-sonnet-5-5, opus=claude-opus-5-5). See docs/development/MODEL_ROUTING.md.

inspect.covers: Reading files, simple code search, repository inventory, configuration inspection, simple log analysis, summaries of known information. Read-only.

docs-format.covers: Formatting, typo and README corrections, small isolated documentation edits that change no described behaviour.

docs-technical.covers: Documentation that explains technical implementation or must stay in sync with code behaviour.

frontend.covers: React components, UI improvements, frontend features, routine frontend bug fixes and small/medium refactors in apps/web.

backend.covers: Routine NestJS implementation, API integration, contracts usage, routine backend bug fixes and small/medium refactors.

tests.covers: Unit, integration, E2E and regression tests.

code-review.covers: Standard bug-focused review of routine changes. High-risk changes need an opus-floor review category instead.

performance.covers: Bundle analysis, frontend performance and routine optimisation.

planning.covers: Implementation planning for multi-step work. Opus for complex or high-risk plans; sonnet acceptable for routine plans. Read-only.

architecture.covers: Architecture design and review, ADR and OD conformance, cross-service integration decisions, major dependency changes.

security.covers: Security, authentication, authorisation, workspace isolation, privacy, secrets handling.

data-integrity.covers: Database integrity and migration design, data provenance, transcript immutability and versioning, deletion completeness.

complex-debug.covers: Complex or cross-module debugging, concurrency problems (queues, races, retries), difficult investigations.

perf-investigation.covers: Difficult performance investigations escalated from the performance category.

final-review.covers: Production-readiness and milestone reviews, and independent review of high-risk work implemented on sonnet.
